name: NATS cluster
description: A NATS cluster: its nodes (units of kind nats), JetStream domain, gateways to other clusters, leaf remotes and the replicas each stream class keeps (forge 20e). The instance agents render each node's nats-server.conf from it and apply a change one node at a time.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The cluster's name (changing it needs every node restarted together: allowFullRestart)

fields.name: JetStream domain
fields.description: The JetStream domain, for a leaf site with its own JetStream (changing it needs allowFullRestart)

fields.name: Nodes
fields.description: The ids of its units of kind nats, one per node

fields.name: Gateways
fields.description: The other clusters it joins: [{name, urls}]

fields.name: Leaf remotes
fields.description: For a leaf site, the hub it connects to: [{url, account, credentials}], credentials a path on the node

fields.name: Ports
fields.description: {client, cluster, gateway, leaf, monitor}: 4222, 6222, 7222, 7422 and 8222 when left out

fields.name: Replicas
fields.description: Replicas per stream class: {events, projections, jobs, …}

fields.name: Allow full restart
fields.description: Lets a change of name or domain, which no node can take alone, restart the nodes one at a time anyway
